snippet.title: I Corrupted My End Island In Hardcore Minecraft
snippet.description:
It's all Ending...

This series is inspired by Sandictions Hardcore series and my desire to see more of it. With him "retiring" i decided that if i wanted to see more videos in that style i'd have to attempt to make them myself. 
This series is the result of that attempt.


Links to things i used this video:

bigbooty17's Enderman Farm : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jn8C8uY3fHM

thebigbaron's Dragon Skull : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=phSaOgHMbdw

UForced's Guardian Farm : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uev4a5yj3Fo

Enjoy :)
